description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance of different models, comparing their relative performance. The horizontal axis lists the model categories, labeled as "Standard", "Self-RAG", "FactTune", and "CInGS (w/)" from left to right, in a specific order without any apparent sorting by value. The vertical axis is labeled "Average Performance" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, with tick labels at intervals of 10. Each model category is represented by a distinct colored bar: "Standard" is orange with a value of approximately 52, "Self-RAG" is beige with a value of around 54, "FactTune" is green with a value of about 51, and "CInGS (w/)" is blue with a value of roughly 59. The bars are not grouped or stacked, and there is no visual emphasis on any particular bar. The chart provides a straightforward comparison of the average performance across the different models.
